version.approval_notes: Build instructions are in docs/AMO_REVIEW.md in the attached sources. Requires Node.js 26 and pnpm 12.18.0: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build:firefox. No developer credentials or remote build service are needed. This is a bring-your-own-key translator: page text, title and domain go directly to the provider configured by the user; the user's API key authenticates those requests. No developer backend, analytics or remote executable code. Firefox 140+ built-in data consent declares websiteContent, browsingActivity and authenticationInfo.
